text:
Maria G: Heads-up — BrightLocal onboarding stalled; renewal in 25 days. Usage flat, they haven't completed the 2-week checklist. Proposing a 'last-mile rescue' (targeted enablement + downgrade-safe save plan). Who can help draft quick steps and join a relaunch call?
AJ: I can pull engagement metrics and the onboarding event logs. Suspect missing GA event + API key. Give me 30m.
Kevin Li: I'll sketch a downgrade path: temporary seat reduction + feature gating so they can keep core infra. Need to know contract minimums.
Sophie L: Recommend a 1hr relaunch call this week with PL + support. Scripted agenda: 1) quick wins 2) unblock ingestion 3) confirm roadmap fit 4) retention options. I'll draft the agenda and checklist.
Onboard-bot: BrightLocal: onboarding step 'dataset_ingest' FAILED on 2025-11-03 14:12 UTC. Attempts=3. Last error: "schema mismatch". Primary contact=engineer@brightlocal.com
Maria G: OK — Kevin, can you add a short downgrade email template + simple credit math? Sophie, please include step-by-step ingestion troubleshooting in the checklist. AJ, attach the usage snapshot when you post.
Kevin Li: Draft email template below — use for sales+cs handoff:
```
Subject: Options to keep BrightLocal on Peak plan
Hi <Name>,
We want to keep you on track for the renewal. Quick options: 1) short-term seat reduction to lower monthly spend, 2) temporary feature gating for non-critical modules, or 3) apply $X in credits while we fix ingestion.
Can we schedule a 30-minute call to choose the best path?
Best,
Kevin (Redwood CS)
```
Maria G: Micro-saves we should try before discounting heavily:
- Apply 2,000 free tokens credit for 7 days.
- Provide a one-click ingestion command sample for them to run: 
```bash
redwood ingest --source s3://brightlocal/datasets/latest --retry 3 --schema-map mapping_v2.json
```
AJ: Metrics snapshot: tokens/day 8k -> 2k over last 4 weeks; active seats 6 -> 2; ingestion errors: 7 in last 10 days (schema mismatch). I'll upload the CSV and funnel charts to the account page.
Sophie L: I can run the relaunch Wed 10am PT. Agenda draft will be in the call doc. @Priya (CS Director) can you join for discount/escalation sign-off?
Priya (CS Director): Confirming Wed 10am PT. Approve up to $5k in credit and a one-time 10% invoice reduction for retention. If they request more, escalate to Sales for margin signoff.
Maria G: Great — I'll own action items and update the 'at-risk' playbook entry after the call. Ops note: tag account with `at-risk-renewal` and `last-mile` in Gainsight; set health to "amber".
Kevin Li: I'll post the downgrade playbook snippet to the shared drive and link it in the account notes.
Sophie L: I'll bring the relaunch script and the ingestion runbook.
AJ: Uploaded metrics and the error dump to the account.
Maria G: Thanks all. Quick check: who will own the follow-up tasks post-call?
Sophie L: I can own troubleshooting + enablement follow-ups.
Priya (CS Director): I'll own the billing/credit approval and follow escalation as needed.
Maria G: Perfect. I'll send the meeting invite and the customer-facing email pre-approval. :thumbsup:
